description: Extract Grotto core values from the regular save. Native game version 1.24 uses current-colony progress, not lifetime mushroom kills.
target: Grotto layers, Monarch HP, mushroom challenge progress, schematic effects, and cavern Opals

extractions.label: colonies_defeated
extractions.description: Defeated Gloomie colonies. Native Monarch defeat increments this saved count.

extractions.label: layer
extractions.description: Native Grotto colony label uses the rounded defeated count plus one, from idleon1.24.txt:261845.

extractions.label: monarch_hp
extractions.description: Current Monarch HP from the native Grotto calculation.

extractions.label: mushroom_kills
extractions.description: Credited mushroom kills for the current colony. Monarch defeat clears this progress; lifetime kills use a separate saved counter.

extractions.label: mushroom_kill_requirement
extractions.description: Mushroom kills required for the current colony before subtracting credited kills. Source: idleon1.24.txt:241194.

extractions.label: mushroom_kills_remaining
extractions.description: Remaining mushroom kills, clamped at zero by the native Grotto calculation.

extractions.label: lootie_bonus_percent
extractions.description: Built Gloomie Lootie schematic Drop Rate bonus, in percent.

extractions.label: expie_bonus_percent
extractions.description: Built Gloomie Expie schematic Class EXP bonus, in percent.

extractions.label: opie_bonus_percent

extractions.label: opals_found
